note: Parser fixes: a return-type alias imported with a plain use (use crate::api::v2::ApiResult) resolves the alias of the module it names instead of being left unexpanded next to a same-named alias elsewhere; an alias of a same-named alias in another module (type Result<T> = crate::error::Result<Json<T>>) is followed; responses = [(204, T)] (and 1xx / 205 / 304) documents no body; #[schema(value_type = T)] wins over a custom serde codec on a flattened field; garde patterns using Rust-only escapes (\<, \>, \b{..}, \U, \u{..}, \a) or a lone } are skipped; the request view of an externally tagged enum documents the map form {"Other": null} of its #[serde(other)] variant.
